name: motion-read-clip
title: Motion: read a clip into its depth, its targets' mask and its first frame
description: Reads up to 10 seconds of a clip at a short side of at most 768 px. Depth Anything 3 Mono-Large makes its depth video, SAM 3.1 tracks up to 3 things named by text into one mask video, and the first frame is saved. The three guide the LTX 2.5 render of Motion's Change a clip.
